synthesis: Atomic capability/authority reservation and intent adequacy solve different failure classes and must both gate consequential effects.
dual_gate_law: user_intent_adequacy != capability_authority; consequential commit requires both
proposed_release_chain: provenance/influence noninterference or equivalent intent-adequacy check
atomic authority reserve binding exact approved intent + current capability/epochs/budget/replay identity
failure_if_intent_gate_missing: A prompt-injected or otherwise context-shifted EffectIntent may be internally consistent, within capability scope and correctly lowered yet still be unjustified by the user's actual task.
failure_if_authority_gate_missing: A user-justified EffectIntent may still execute with stale, widened, revoked, replayed or cumulatively overspent authority.

external_support.finding: NIST explicitly frames agent identity/authorization, auditing/non-repudiation and prompt-injection mitigation as linked problems for software/AI agents.

OWASP recommends least-privilege tool policy, structural separation of trusted/untrusted inputs, high-impact confirmation and action logging tied to originating input; its over-privileged-skills guidance explicitly notes tool-level permission can still be abused when natural-language intent is coerced.

IGAC independently argues that static tool credentials are necessary but insufficient because a tool call can be credential-authorized yet unjustified by the user's current request; user intent narrows rather than expands authority.
Prompt-injection evidence supports provenance/role separation: untrusted text can acquire apparent authority when models infer role from content rather than source.
NCS independently separates untrusted neural planning from deterministic authorization of exact workflow steps and rejects mismatched/out-of-order tool calls.

evidence_boundary: External work supports the mechanism class and problem separation; it does not validate ClayCode's exact UserIntentContract or atomic reservation design.
fusion_request: Treat intent adequacy/noninterference as an additional P0 RC2 gate and bind the successful intent decision into authority_reservation_id/contract_instance_hash so later lowering cannot swap the approved action.
